lyrics:
[Intro: piano and chiming guitar]

[Verse 1: raspy warm male voice]
We were twenty, we were certain
That the real thing was somewhere else
A bigger town, a better year
A different version of ourselves

[Pre-Chorus: bass enters]
We'd sit out here and make the plans
With our backs against this wall

[Chorus: drums crash in, full band]
And right here was always it
Same porch, same sky, same you
We kept looking past it for the place it starts
It was started, and we never knew
Baby, I've quit looking
Right here was always it

[Verse 2: voice closer, guitar answering]
Now the kids have come and gone
And the plans are in a drawer
I don't know when I stopped wanting
What I wanted so much more

[Pre-Chorus: band building]
I just know I looked at you tonight
And had nowhere else to be

[Chorus: full band, harmonies]
And right here was always it
Same porch, same sky, same you
We kept looking past it for the place it starts
It was started, and we never knew
Baby, I've quit looking
Right here was always it

[Guitar Solo: melodic, over the chorus chords]

[Bridge: piano and voice]
If I could tell those two kids anything
I'd tell them, look down. Look around.

[Final Chorus: biggest, key up, held last note]
Right here was always it
Same porch, same sky, same you
We kept looking past it for the place it starts
It was started, and we never knew
Baby, I've quit looking
Right here was always it

[Outro: chiming guitar, a porch board creaking, crickets]
